name: Crypto Link Check
description: Compares a URL with the official domains of ~60 wallets, exchanges and dapps and flags lookalike characters, typosquats, punycode, free hosting and bait words like 'claim'. Tools: check_crypto_link (free) and full_report_info (explains the optional paid full check, 0.005 USDC on Base over x402; the tool itself does not pay). No account or API key.
author: devx-agent
